verdict.rationale: Paxos exposes a conventional REST API (with OAuth, sandbox, webhooks, and orchestration endpoints like mint/redeem) that abstracts underlying blockchain mechanics into simple calls such as 'convert USD to stablecoins and transfer in one call,' and no mention of nodes/gas/chain management appears anywhere in the docs, implying full abstraction. However, there is no evidence of official client libraries/SDKs in specific programming languages — only raw REST/FIX/WebSocket API references — and the probe confirms no discoverable OpenAPI spec, weakening the 'client libraries in my language' claim. missing for 10: language-specific SDKs/client libraries, an OpenAPI/spec artifact, independent confirmation of gas/node abstraction.
